title: Order every part at teardown
explanation: All 5 slow jobs needed two or more supplements, so doing a full teardown and ordering every part on day one stops cars from sitting while new parts and approvals catch up.
basedOn: VAB-1038, VAB-1022, VAB-1031, VAB-1015, VAB-1007 · Supplement rate

title: Check stalled cars every morning
explanation: A five-minute daily review of any car past its expected date would have caught VAB-1038 and VAB-1022 when they were days late instead of three weeks late.

title: Get supplement approvals the same day
explanation: Send photos and the revised estimate to the insurer the moment hidden damage is found, so approvals don't eat into the promised delivery date.
